Everything below was read on this phone. Luwi collects no personal content and uploads no private data: no screenshots, no screen content, no chats or typing, no contacts, files, accounts or API keys. Nothing leaves this phone unless you press “Report anonymously”.

Why reporting helps: the same “it does nothing” can come from the privileged channel, accessibility, the virtual screen, the models or storage. The report spells out all eight, so the author can reproduce and fix it. You do not need to describe the problem — paste this report in the group, or press report.
Only this report goes out — okay?

What is sent is exactly the report above, ten lines:
· app version (e.g. 2.8.0 (19))
· model / system / SDK / language (e.g. Xiaomi M2012K10C (ares) · Android 13 (SDK 33) · zh_CN)
· one line per check, each just OK/WARN/FAIL plus a sentence; the eight checks are app, device, host, Node, privileged channel, accessibility, virtual screen, storage.

What is never sent: screenshots or screen content, chats or typing, contacts / files / photos, accounts or API keys, host logs, any unique device identifier (no IMEI, ANDROID_ID or advertising ID, and we generate no install id). Like any website, the server sees your IP address, but we store no identifier tied to it.
Still stuck? Come to the QQ group %1$s (tap this line to copy the number, then paste the report above). Things get fixed faster there, and it helps us too.
